title: 2 Chronicles 1-12 qualified-row primary-context research ledger
scope: Research ledger only. The source map, selector, derived data and first-release resources were not changed. These are proposals before independent re-review, not approved map changes.
method: All rows currently marked qualified by the bound reclosure were extracted. Each row includes pinned WEB text and adjacent verse context with URLs and text hashes. Dan and Benjamin book-local collective profiles were reread for the two proposed existing-ID corrections. Terms without a verified suitable existing ID remain unresolved; no IDs were invented.
limitations: This is source-context research, not an independent review.
The row set is qualified status in the bound reclosure; unchanged links are not runtime approval.
No new collective, feature, priestly-group, ethnic-group or watercourse IDs were created.
